newsitem.title: UK: Colombia, Argentina oil mins to address CGES seminar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia, Argentina oil mins to address CGES seminar.

text.p: The Colombian and Argentine energy ministers next month will address a conference on the outlook for oil and gas in Latin America chaired by former Saudi oil minister Sheikh Ahmed Zaki Yamani.

The London conference organised by the Centre for Global Energy Studies founded by Yamani will hear speeches from Colombian energy minister Rodrigo Villamizar and Argentinian energy minister Alfredo Mirkin.

Other keynote speakers at the conference on April 21 and 22 will include Chile's energy minister Alejandro Jadresic, Bolivia's minister of economic Development Jaime Villalobos, Petroleos de Venezuela SA president Luis Giusti, Petroleo Brasileiro SA - Petrobras president Joel Mendes Renno and Repsol SA chairman Alfonso Cortina de Alcocer.
